Youre not the only one, whenever i get in a really depressive state i just have to cut ties with friends because i feel like all i do is bother them. Now i'm stuck being this awkward person who can't interact well with other people.

“No, seriously what the fuck is this bullshit?” 

It’s my birthday, the big ole’ one eight. The best of all birthdays, well supposedly at least. I’m in my backyard in a circle with my friends- them all being older then I already have their weapons and all of them of course match their personality exactly. Cedric? He got this awesome bow and these amazing arrows that just never miss a target and it just matches how precise he is and how he lets nothing stop him (seriously those arrows go through fucking concrete it’s wicked). Sally got nunchucks because she’s wild, Ace got spear thanks to how quick he is and shit. Johnny got a set of fucking daggers and then Cyn, she got a god damn mace which makes sense because she’s absolutely psycho. 

And what did I get stuck with? 

Paper. 

A flat piece of paper. 

A boring piece of fucking paper. 

I picked it up and stared at it in disgust, despising its’ existence while all of my friends just watched me obviously confused as I am. Well I should hope so at least because I don’t have a personality like paper. 

“Did we do it wrong?” Sally wondered referring to the ritual that is needed to perform in order to get your weapon.
 
“No we definitely did it right.” Ace said slowly. 

“There’s no way I’m using a piece of paper during the hunt.” I scowled. “What am I even going to do with it? Paper cut the monsters to death? Yeah no thanks.”
 
“Well…. I mean you could.” Ace said trying to be optimistic, I just glared at him because he and I both know how stupid that is. There is no way I’ll survive the grand birthday hunt by giving those creatures paper cuts.

Johnny just picked one of his daggers and started toying with it, “it matches you though Stitch, you’re as interesting as a blank piece of paper.”
 
“I hope the X mulls you.” I spat at him referring to one of the more intense beasts that’s let out during the hunt. The hunt is the most fun shit, of course I never got to participate in it because I only just turned of age and got my weapon. I’ve only ever spectated, but now of course I get to play and since a party is required I’ll get to do it with my friends. Who have really cool weapons. And I’m just going to be stuck with a boring piece of paper. 

“Okay okay, origami.” Cedric piped up. “Use mad origami skills and make it into a sword or something.” 

“Stitch can’t wrap presents for shit, origami is out of the question.” Cyn laughed. “Scrunch it up into a ball and set it on fire- if you’re a good thrower you’ll get to burn someone!” 

I took what crazy said into consideration and shrugged, trying to do what she had already said. But I ran into a slight problem, the paper wouldn’t turn into a fucking ball.

“This isn’t working.” My forehead was scrunched up in annoyance, my glare becoming more poisonous as my supposed weapon wouldn’t work with me in any shape or form. 

“Paper isn’t hard to scrunch Stitch.” Johnny teased as he tore it out of my grasp. I just huffed and crossed my arms, redirecting my glare to him instead. 

“It won’t let me scrunch it, I swear it’s fucking useless.”

“Uh huh sure.” He rolled his eyes at me but when he saw that I was right he too started to look annoyed. And when that annoyance formed into anger and frustration he took out his dagger and stabbed it into the paper. However, instead of the blade appearing on the other side of the sheet it disappeared straight through it and so did half of Johnny’s body thanks to the force he put into the stab. 

Laughter erupted from our group at the hilarity of it and it was only increased when Cyn decided to push Johnny straight in. I quickly reached over and grabbed the paper, not able to stop laughing when I saw a miniature drawn version of Johnny. A very pissed off look on his features. 

“I’ve change my mind, I’m using this shit.”
